entries.title: Micah 1:1
segments: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

entries.title: Micah 1:2
segments: Hear, all you people; listen, O earth, and its fullness. And let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.

entries.title: Micah 1:3
segments: For behold, the LORD [is] coming out of His place, and will come down and walk on the high places of the earth.

entries.title: Micah 1:4
segments: And the mountains shall melt under Him, and the valleys shall tear themselves, as wax before the fire, and as waters poured down a steep place.

entries.title: Micah 1:5
segments: All this [is] for the transgression of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What [is] the transgression of Jacob? [Is it] not Samaria? And what [are] the high places of Judah? [Are they] not Jerusalem?

entries.title: Micah 1:6
segments: And I will make Samaria into ruins of the field, planting places for a vineyard; and I will pour down her stones into the valley, and I will uncover her foundations.

entries.title: Micah 1:7
segments: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her gifts shall be burned with the fire, and I will destroy all its idols. For she gathered it from the reward of a harlot, and they shall return to the reward of a harlot.

entries.title: Micah 1:8
segments: Therefore I will wail and howl; I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like jackals, mourn like the daughters of an ostrich.

entries.title: Micah 1:9
segments: For her wounds [are] not curable; for it has come to Judah; it has reached to the gate of My people, to Jerusalem.

entries.title: Micah 1:10
segments: Do not declare [it] in Gath; weep not at all; in the house of Leaphrah roll [in] the dust.

entries.title: Micah 1:11
segments: Pass over to them, O dweller of Shaphir, in nakedness of shame. The dweller of Zaanan has not gone out; the mourning of Beth-ezel shall take from you his standing.

entries.title: Micah 1:12
segments: For be grieved for good, the dweller of Maroth, for evil came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Micah 1:13
segments: O inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the stallion; she [is] the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion, for the sins of Israel were found in you.

entries.title: Micah 1:14
segments: Therefore you shall give parting gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib [are] for a lying thing to the kings of Israel.

entries.title: Micah 1:15
segments: Yet I will bring an heir to you, O dweller of Mareshah. The glory of Israel shall come to Adullam.

entries.title: Micah 1:16
segments: Make yourself bald, and cut off [your hair] for the sons of your delight; make your baldness large like the eagle; for they go into exile from you.
